description: Land Reform Commission - Order to declare that the agricultural lands in Pahala Malagane and Thekawa, Kurunegala District shall vest in Shalitha Gihan Maralanda Wijewardene and Haritha Lakshman Dilan Maralanda Wijewardene and the land in Gorakadeniya in Shalani Mayanthi Maralanda Wijewardene
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the vesting of agricultural lands to named individuals under the Land Reform Law. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, boundaries, and ownership transfers, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
